Package org.cyclops.integratedterminals.client.gui.container.component

Class CraftingPlanGraphCamera

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.integratedterminals.client.gui.container.component.CraftingPlanGraphCamera
public class CraftingPlanGraphCamera extends Object
The pan and zoom state of a graph inside a viewport. The camera stores the viewport-relative position of the graph origin, so the view stays steady when the graph around the origin changes. This class is independent of Minecraft, so it can be unit-tested and ported easily.

    • zoomAt

      public boolean zoomAt(double viewX, double viewY, int direction)
      Change the zoom level while keeping the graph point under the given view position in place. Zooming past or close to the default level stops at it, as that is where graphs look sharpest.
      Parameters:
      viewX - The anchor X position in the viewport.
      viewY - The anchor Y position in the viewport.
      direction - Positive to zoom in, negative to zoom out.
      Returns:
      If the zoom level changed.

    • fit

      public void fit(CraftingPlanGraphLayout.Bounds bounds, int viewWidth, int viewHeight)
      Zoom in as far as possible while the whole graph fits, and center it. If it does not even fit at the smallest zoom level, the root is aligned to the left center.
      Parameters:
      bounds - The graph bounds.
      viewWidth - The viewport width.
      viewHeight - The viewport height.

    • reset

      public void reset(CraftingPlanGraphLayout.Bounds bounds, int viewWidth, int viewHeight)
      Like fit(CraftingPlanGraphLayout.Bounds, int, int), but without zooming in as far, so that small graphs do not look oversized when they are first shown.
      Parameters:
      bounds - The graph bounds.
      viewWidth - The viewport width.
      viewHeight - The viewport height.
